      <div class="hc-bio">
        <p>I study the gap between technology access and welfare outcomes in agriculture, with a focus on impact evaluation, food security, and post-conflict rural development across Latin America and Sub-Saharan Africa.</p>
        <p>I am a Postdoctoral Researcher in Applied Economics and Impact Evaluation at the <a href="https://alliancebioversityciat.org/" target="_blank">Alliance of Bioversity International and CIAT</a> (<a href="https://www.cgiar.org/" target="_blank">CGIAR</a>), and hold a PhD in Economics from <a href="https://economia.uniandes.edu.co/" target="_blank">Universidad de los Andes</a>, Bogotá.</p>
        <p>My work has been published in journals including <a href="https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/agricultural-systems" target="_blank">Agricultural Systems</a>, <a href="https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/journal-of-rural-studies" target="_blank">Journal of Rural Studies</a>, and <a href="https://link.springer.com/journal/10640" target="_blank">Environmental and Resource Economics</a>, and I have contributed to multi-country research initiatives with CGIAR and international development organizations.</p>
      </div>
